blog_summary: The blog post marks the end of a term for 'The Morning Paper' and announces a two-week break. It highlights a selection of notable research papers reviewed over the past three months, covering diverse topics such as machine learning (chess and shogi), security (qmail), programming paradigms, quantum computing, blockchain consensus, privacy, and distributed systems (Anna KVS). The author expresses appreciation for the breadth and quality of research shared, noting the difficulty in choosing just a few highlights. The post serves as a retrospective of recent interesting work across multiple domains.
